generic.Defined scope/population: The approved commission schedule version and the products, channels and producer tiers it covers
generic.In-scope period: From the schedule effective date to the end date of the version being activated
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Schedule version, effective date, status, release ticket and deploying user recorded on the schedule row
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Active rate row count in production equals the approved rate row count promoted from UAT
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Release ticket, promotion log and post-activation test result stored against the schedule version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any post-activation rate mismatch logged with cause and a fix or rollback decision
generic.Test population: The activated schedule version plus one live bound policy run through the engine after activation
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero rate variance on the live test policy and zero overlapping active date ranges
generic.Exception handling path: A rate mismatch or wrong status halts activation and is escalated to the Distribution Operations Manager
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Status is Active on the approved effective date with a release ticket reference and no version overlap
generic.Evidence location: Release ticket in the billing/commission platform change log and the schedule version register

steps.title: Promote the approved schedule from UAT to production in the billing/commission platform
sop: Open the approved release ticket and confirm it names the exact schedule version to promote
Run the promotion job rather than re-keying rate rows directly in production
Done when the schedule version exists in production referencing the release ticket
verify: Compare the promoted rate row count in production to the approved UAT rate row count
Pass when production rate rows match UAT exactly and cite the release ticket

steps.title: Set the schedule status and effective date in the billing/commission platform
sop: Confirm the status is Pending until the approved effective date and flips to Active on that date
Confirm the effective date matches the approved schedule design and not the promotion date
Done when status and effective date match the approved schedule
verify: Query the schedule header for status and effective date
Pass when status is Active only from the approved effective date

steps.title: End-date the superseded schedule version in the billing/commission platform
sop: Set the prior version end date to the day before the new effective date
Check no product or tier has a date gap or overlap across the two versions
Done when the prior version is closed with no gap or overlap
verify: Run the overlapping-date-range check for each product and tier combination
Pass when no product/tier has two active schedule versions on any date

steps.title: Run one live bound policy through the commission engine after activation
sop: Select a bound policy dated on or after the effective date on an in-scope product
Compare the engine commission to the approved rate table value for that product and tier
Done when the engine result equals the approved rate table value
verify: Recompute the expected commission independently from the approved rate table
Pass when engine and independent values agree to the cent

steps.title: Confirm producer tier mapping resolves in the agency/producer management system
sop: Check that in-scope producer codes carry the tier used by the activated schedule
Confirm no in-scope producer code falls back to the system default rate
Done when every in-scope producer code resolves to an activated schedule row
verify: List in-scope producer codes with no matched schedule row
Pass when the unmatched list is empty

steps.title: Confirm segregation of duties on the production deployment record
sop: Check the deploying user against the schedule builder and approver on the release ticket
Reject the activation where the same user built, approved or deployed the change
Done when the deployer is confirmed independent of the builder and approver
verify: Compare the deployer user ID to the builder and approver user IDs
Pass when the three user IDs are not the same person

steps.title: File activation evidence against the schedule version register
sop: Attach the promotion log, live test result and release ticket to the schedule version
Stamp the activation timestamp and the deploying user on the register row
Done when the register row carries activation evidence and timestamp
verify: Open the register row and check each attachment is present and readable
Pass when promotion log, test result and ticket are all attached

generic.Defined scope/population: All tier bands and bonus thresholds in the commission schedule being built for the in-scope products
generic.In-scope period: The tier measurement period defined for the schedule, with its true-up point
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Lower bound, upper bound, rate, retroactive flag and measurement basis populated on every tier row
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Tier band count in the engine equals the band count in the signed schedule design
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Boundary test workings and the signed schedule design retained against the schedule version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any tier band that cannot be modelled in the engine logged with its workaround decision
generic.Test population: One producer tested at each band boundary, at threshold, one dollar under and one dollar over
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero gaps or overlaps between consecutive bands and zero boundary test variances
generic.Exception handling path: A boundary mispay or overlapping band blocks build sign-off and returns to schedule design
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Bands contiguous, retroactive versus incremental set explicitly and measurement basis stated
generic.Evidence location: Tier configuration screen in the billing/commission platform and the Excel boundary test workbook

steps.title: Enter each tier band with explicit bounds in the billing/commission platform
sop: Key the lower and upper written-premium bound for every band from the signed design
Leave no band open-ended unless the design states an uncapped top band
Done when every band has explicit bounds recorded
verify: Sort bands by lower bound and inspect the boundaries between consecutive rows
Pass when no gap or overlap exists between any two consecutive bands

steps.title: Set the retroactive or incremental payment flag on each tier in the engine
sop: Select retroactive-to-first-dollar or incremental-on-excess per the signed schedule design

verify: Compare each band flag to the design document line by line
Pass when every band flag matches the signed design

steps.title: Configure the bonus threshold measurement basis in the billing/commission platform
sop: Set written versus earned premium and gross versus net of cancellations explicitly

Done when the basis is explicitly set rather than inherited
verify: Open the threshold configuration and read the stored basis values
Pass when the basis is explicitly set and matches the design

steps.title: Set the tier measurement period and true-up point in the engine
sop: Select calendar year, policy year or rolling twelve months per the design

verify: Read back the measurement period and true-up point from the schedule header
Pass when both match the signed design

steps.title: Build the boundary test workbook in Microsoft Excel
sop: Build expected commission at threshold, one dollar under and one dollar over for each band

verify: Check that each band has three independently derived expected values
Pass when no band boundary is missing an expected value

steps.title: Run the boundary tests through the commission engine and compare

verify: List all cases where engine and expected values differ
Pass when the variance list is empty

verify: Open the grandfathering rule and confirm it covers renewal business

steps.title: End-date the superseded schedule version in the billing/commission platform
sop: Enter an explicit end date on the prior version rather than leaving it open
Set the end date to the day before the new effective date

verify: List schedule versions with no end date for the same product and tier

sop: Run one policy dated the day before and one the day after the effective date

verify: Check the schedule version carries a recorded review outcome
